'''Bean and Green Chili Soup''' - An easy, surprising soup from easily stored ingredients

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (480 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) [[Cookbook:rice|cooked rice]]
*1 can (16 oz, 450 g) [[Cookbook:Refried Beans|refried beans]]
*1 can (16 oz, 450 g) [[Cookbook:Black Beans|black beans]]
*1 small can (4 oz, 110 g) green [[Cookbook:Salsa|salsa]]
*1 ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (300 [[Cookbook:mL|ml]]) dried, bulk black bean soup mix
*[[Cookbook:Sour Cream|Sour cream]] (optional)

==Procedure==
# Bring 1 cup (240 ml) dry rice and 2 cups (480 ml) water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Turn heat to low and steam rice for 25–30 min (or prepare rice using [[Cookbook:Rice Cooker|rice cooker]]).
# Prepare soup mix by combining with 3 cups (720 ml) boiling water, then [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] about 5 minutes.
# Add remaining ingredients and rice to soup.
# Heat through, stirring occasionally.
# If desired, just before serving, spoon a teaspoon of sour cream in to the middle of the bowl.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* This recipe is surprisingly flavorful for being prepared form preserved ingredients. With a dollop of sour cream for garnish, it is even better.
